title: Detection event
description: The detector's gate opened (drift) or the person pressed "I'm off" (manual). It reports drift from the person's own calibrated peak, never a mood. D-contracts-007, D-sensing-005.

stateId.description: The state the person drifted from.

window.description: The window that opened the gate. Null for manual events.

hrDelta.description: hrMean minus the peak calibration mean.

rmssdDelta.description: rmssd minus the peak calibration value.

z.description: Weighted distance from peak in pooled SDs.

position.description: Place on the peak-to-contrast axis: 0 at peak, 1 at contrast. Null unless calibrationMode is contrast.

sham.description: True: the cue is withheld on this trial. Manual events are never sham.

calibrationMode.description: contrast: peak and contrast separable; on-only: distance from peak only; generic: no calibration, resting prior.
